title: Goal frame and tracker
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y5 lesson 9 (Goal frame and tracker (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 9: Goal-setting, motivation and role models. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Specific: memorise Surah al-Mulk ayat 1 to 5
Steps: one ayah every two days
Check: recite to a parent each Friday

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A specific, timed goal with steps

panels.title: Role models
points: The Prophet ﷺ: the best example
Parents, teachers, people who help others

panels.title: Qualities of a good role model

keywords.def: the reason that keeps us going
someone whose good example we follow
niyyah, the reason in our heart (نِيَّة)

questions.a: For example: walk 20 minutes every day for 3 weeks.

questions.q: Core: Write your own goal with three steps, a date and a niyyah (pupil PDF).
questions.a: A specific goal with steps, a date and intention.

questions.q: Extend: Name a role model and two qualities that will help you with your goal.
questions.a: For example: my grandfather: patience and hard work.

questions.q: Stretch: Plan what you will do if you miss a step.
questions.a: Restart the next day, adjust the plan, ask for support.

options: Read 20 minutes every night until half term
questions.a: B) Read 20 minutes every night until half term. It says what, how often and until when.

questions.q: A role model is... A) someone famous B) someone whose good example we follow C) a computer
questions.a: B) someone whose good example we follow
options: Someone whose good example we follow

questions.q: Big question: what is your goal and your first step?
questions.a: A specific goal and first step.
